name: Pipeliners - Keyword Map 2026-08-19
body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
Keyword mapping data from Aug 19-20, folded into one note:
- `pipeliners-keyword-map-2026-08-19.csv`: 24 URLs with priority (6 HIGH, 9 MEDIUM, 9 LOW), WP post ID, primary target keyword, supporting keywords, page intent, whether content satisfies intent, GSC 90-day impressions and best position, cannibalization risk and recommended on-page action. Example: the leak detection page targets "leak detection Phoenix AZ" and was flagged as a critical intent mismatch.
- `pipeliners-PAGE2-by-page-2026-08-20.tsv`: 45 pages with keywords on page 2 of Google (GSC 28 days, positions 11-20). Buckeye had 11 page-2 keywords (pipe break and water line repair terms), Paradise Valley 8, Glendale 9.
- `pipeliners-position-verification-2026-08-19.tsv`: checked a "current position" sheet against GSC and the rank tracker for 8 opportunity keywords. 4 were wrong or stale (for example "pipe relining vs replacement cost" was really position 74, not as listed; Florence pipe break repair had improved to 8 in GSC and 5 in KRT).

# Use
These fed the Aug 19 OTTO meta keyword deployment and later title work. Positions are a snapshot; use the Website Pages tracker and Scorecard for current data.
